1. (Currently Amended) A cell comprising: a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising __a plurality of__ bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptides.

2. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the non-native compartment is self-assembled in vivo.

3. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the non-native compartment further comprises at least one targeted enzyme selected from the group consisting of propanediol utilization enzymes.

4. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 3 wherein the non-native compartment comprises a plurality of different targeted enzymes for the conversion of propanediol.

5. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 3 wherein the at least one targeted enzyme comprises a compartment-specific targeting signal sequence for efficient localization within the non-native compartment.

8. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the proteinaceous shell comprises a plurality of different BMC polypeptides from different bacterial species.

9. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 8 wherein the plurality of different BMC polypeptides comprises BMC polypeptides from different BMC operons linked to metabolic pathways.

10. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the BMC polypeptide comprises an affinity tag selected from the group consisting of histidine tags, GST tags, and Myc tags.

11. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 comprising a plurality of compartments, the compartments being distinct from one another.
